audience: Adult Russian-speaking beginners in Serbia; prior Serbian knowledge is probed, not assumed.
scope: Written Serbian only. Standard Ekavian is the editorial baseline; both Latin and Cyrillic are assessed as separate conditions. Reviewed valid variants remain eligible.

cefr_source.title: Common European Framework of Reference for Languages: Learning, Teaching, Assessment — Companion Volume

targets.function: link a specified item to its price

outcomes.function: Give basic personal details and read a short fictional profile.
outcomes.written_task: Read a new fictional registration prompt; complete its requested name, residence and short self-description fields. Never request real personal data.

rubric.communicative_success: Judge whether requested fictional details are present and interpretable; report missing or contradictory fields.
rubric.target_accuracy: Separately judge the elicited copula/personal form; accept reviewed equivalent word orders and spelling variants.
rubric.support: Keep unaided first submission separate from hints, correction and unresolved responses.

outcomes.scope_note: Reading and short writing only; no spoken self-introduction claim.

outcomes.function: Request a specified everyday item politely.
outcomes.written_task: Given a new service scenario and one named item, compose one short written request to obtain it.

rubric.communicative_success: Judge whether the item and request intent are clear and socially suitable in context.
rubric.target_accuracy: Separately judge the reviewed request construction and item form; accept preapproved polite variants.
rubric.support: Record model display and revisions; only an unaided first submission enters first-attempt accuracy.

outcomes.scope_note: Written rehearsal of an interaction descriptor; no oral transaction claim.

outcomes.function: Find a simple price for a specified item.
outcomes.written_task: Read an unfamiliar short price notice with several items and give the requested item's price.

rubric.communicative_success: Judge whether amount and currency belong to the requested item rather than another line.
rubric.target_accuracy: Separately judge recognition of the item-price link; do not require broad menu comprehension or productive numeral agreement.
rubric.support: Record first unaided selection and later correction separately; ambiguous notices or answers are unresolved.

outcomes.scope_note: Short written notices only; no listening or general purchasing claim.

outcomes.function: Give simple location information in a short message.
outcomes.written_task: Read a new fictional arrangement and write where a named place is and, if prompted, when to return.

rubric.communicative_success: Judge whether the reader can identify the place and any requested return time.
rubric.target_accuracy: Separately judge a reviewed static-location construction; do not infer destination or locative-paradigm mastery.
rubric.support: Score unaided first message separately from prompted rewrites; unreviewed variants need human adjudication.

outcomes.scope_note: Short written location/return-time message only; no navigation or oral direction claim.
